pages.title: Paired Mats
pages.text: Tatami mats are made for Gensokyo-style rooms. When you place them with at least two mats in hand, they normally form a connected two-part mat, giving you a neat floor pattern.

If there is only one mat available, or there is not enough room in front of you, a single square mat is placed instead. Breaking a paired mat separates it again, and each half returns one tatami. Full-height tatami blocks work the same way.
